note: Smallest corpus in the set: 3 theories, 8 problems, 4 desiderata, 9 sections. Ingest one cycle per section into a named subgraph. Use as the smoke test before the QM corpus.
revision: 2026-07-28: run 1 correctly REFUTED newcomb_lesion_tension because the corpus asserted the conclusion without its derivation. Sections 2 and 3 now carry the two bridging entailments explicitly. The refutation was a correct engine result against a defective corpus.

mustFind.note: The central result. Requires the two bridging entailments from sections 2 and 3: dominance -> -newcomb_adequacy (Newcomb's payoff structure), evidential_responsiveness -> -lesion_adequacy (the lesion's confounded correlation). Without those the four desiderata are unrelated predicates and the set is trivially SAT — which is exactly what run 1 found.
A theory demanding every chosen act be ratifiable is silent in Death in Damascus. Arity 2 and easy — if AGEM misses this one the extraction is broken, not the search.
EDT's own machinery forces paying; refusing requires abandoning act-conditional evaluation.

mustNotFind.why: CDT is internally consistent. It loses Newcomb; losing an argument is not a contradiction.
EDT is internally consistent. It loses the lesion and XOR blackmail.
FDT satisfies both adequacy conditions by changing what is evaluated. Consistent; contested on other grounds.
Opposed verdicts on one problem by different theories. Positions-incompatible, not a corpus contradiction. Tripwire for the ToM HOT/HOP failure mode.

openQuestions.note: Does FDT satisfy a weakened dominance (over policies rather than acts) that still counts as satisfying the desideratum? If so the arity-4 MUS has an escape route nobody has stated cleanly.
Enumerate every maximal satisfiable subset of the desiderata. Each MSS is a coherent decision-theoretic position, including ones no named theory occupies. That list is the actual deliverable.
